title: pr-team terminals.jsonl - shared $defs
description: Shared field $defs used by both the reviewer-row schema and the fixer-row schema.

agent_id.description: A regex-compatible identifier - for non-closer rows, exactly matches the originating dispatch_plan.json agents[].id; for the closer row (CLOSEOUT atomic close), the shim hardcodes the literal value `closer`. 'closer' is the shim-reserved literal, enforced by convention rather than a separate regex branch.

agent_role.description: Coarse role discriminator recorded on every row. `reviewer` for Step 2 fan-out returns (rows match terminals.reviewer.schema.json). `fixer` for Step 5 fixer-fan-out returns AND the Step 6 closer return (rows match terminals.fixer.schema.json). The closer is technically a fixer-mode agent (MODE=CLOSEOUT) - distinguished from individual fixers by `agent_id == 'closer'`.

ts.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp the shim recorded when parsing the agent's return. Useful for sequencing parallel returns; not required because file is line-ordered by append order anyway.

output_path.description: Repo-relative path inside the checkout; rooted, drive-letter, UNC and parent-directory paths are forbidden. The shim verifies existence-on-disk at parse time; missing path is treated as STOP_PROTOCOL.
output_path.$comment: Cross-platform path audit: the regex blocks a leading `/` or `\` (Unix absolute, Windows rooted, UNC `\\server` and `//server`), any drive prefix (`C:\foo`, `C:/foo`, drive-relative `C:foo`) and any `..` segment under either separator. Repo-relative is the only legal shape.

notes.description: Optional freeform one-line note from the agent.

partial_output.description: FAIL: optional path to whatever was written before failure.

issue_id.description: The ID assigned to a problem detected by a reviewer agent. These are carried in arrays (e.g. `issue_id_list`) and cross-referenced by fixers. The prefix letter encodes the issue type: `C` for code issues, `I` for infra issues, `M` for misc issues. The numeric portion is a simple integer sequence (e.g. C1, C2, C3... I1, I2... M1, M2...).

issue_description.$comment: Named `issue_description` (NOT `description`) to avoid colliding with the JSON-Schema reserved meta-keyword.

issue_id_list.description: Array of unique issue IDs (no duplicates allowed).
